name: dex-demo
description: Local DEX operator pattern that installs the DEX contract pack and prepares endpoints for the web app and automation tests.
use_case: Run the Xian DEX under known contract names so wallets, the SnakX web app, automation services, and integration tests can rely on the same AMM surface.

starter_flows.name: local
starter_flows.summary: Run a local indexed node, install the DEX contract pack with the local-demo recipe, and seed a demo liquid pair.

steps.title: Create and start the local indexed node
notes: Run these commands from the xian-stack checkout.
The base localnet starts without the DEX. Install the contract pack next.

steps.title: Install the DEX contract pack
commands: uv run xian contract-pack install dex --recipe local-demo --stack-dir ../xian-stack
notes: Run this command from the xian-cli checkout.
This deploys the pinned DEX contract pack bundle and seeds the demo pool.
